author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR023209 D-amino-acid oxidase is currently annotated with [D-amino acid metabolic process (GO:0046416)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0046416)

It would be more accurate to annotate with the child term D-amino acid catabolic process ([GO:0019478](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0019478)).

This is consistent with the abstract of the PMID used for the Description: "d-Amino acid oxidase (DAO) and d-aspartate oxidase (DDO) are degradative enzymes stereospecific for d-amino acids."

---

IPR011780 D-serine ammonia-lyase is also currently annotated with [D-amino acid metabolic process (GO:0046416)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0046416).

Here, it would be better to use the more specific term '[GO:0036088 D-serine catabolic process](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0036088)'.

---

I mention these proposals partly because GO:0046416 is proposed to be obsoleted - see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32062
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR023209 D-amino-acid oxidase & IPR011780 D-serine ammonia-lyase
